Automate the tasks you repeat every day

We automate calculations and document generation and coordinate approvals and notifications through defined workflows. Your team can spend less time repeating steps and focus on decisions and exceptions that need human input.

Tell us what you needSee real projects

What we can automate

When a task repeats with known rules, we can assess which steps to automate and which controls to keep.

Billing based on each contract's rules

Checking discounts and periods manually every month takes time and can cause discrepancies. We automate calculations and invoice generation from recorded agreements, accounting for each client's terms.

For example

Monthly invoices applying discounts by period and different terms by country.

Documents without entering data again

Preparing a proposal or order often means copying information between spreadsheets and documents. We connect available data with the rules and templates needed to generate the document within the same process.

For example

An insertion order generated from the quote and linked to the deal in the CRM.

Approvals and notifications with clear ownership

A process can stall because someone needs to request a review or remind others of the next step. We define workflows that request the right approval, record its status and notify the people who need to act.

For example

A proposal requiring approval before proceeding, notifying its owner when it is ready for review.

Real projects

Processes already applying business rules to reduce calculations, data entry and manual document preparation.

Automation · Billing

Monthly billing with rules per contract

Each membership has discounts, periods and terms that must apply at billing. We built a workflow that takes those agreements from HubSpot and generates invoices in Odoo.

The solution processes more than 15,000 monthly invoices in hours, accounting for the rules of four countries. The team maintains agreements in the CRM without calculating and entering every invoice separately.

Calculations and documents within the quote

Despegar's quoting tool applies pricing and budget rules, validates allocation across brands and countries and generates the insertion order. The proposal is linked to the deal in HubSpot.

The team went from preparing quotes in hours to completing them in minutes. Calculations and sales documentation are part of the same workflow.

How we work

Audit, design, implementation and support can be engaged separately. We can help you choose an initial process or work on automation already defined, with agreed scope and deliverables.

Choose what to automate

We review task frequency, effort, delays and common errors. We identify steps with clear rules and the information or tools needed to address them.

You receive

An assessment with priorities and a recommendation for the selected process.

Define the workflow and its controls

We document what starts the process, which actions run, who approves and how exceptions are handled. We agree on acceptance criteria and a measure of improvement, such as response time or manual interventions needed.

You receive

The workflow design, rules, owners and validation criteria.

Put the process into operation

We build or configure the agreed workflow and test typical situations and relevant exceptions. We validate it with your team and hand over what is needed to operate it; if you have a design, we review those materials before starting.

You receive

The agreed automation, with testing, documentation and handover to its operators.

Handle workflow incidents and adjustments

We support automation in use with agreed monthly capacity. We handle incidents, maintenance and minor adjustments; changes that expand scope are assessed and quoted separately.

Includes

Service and maintenance for the workflows defined in the contracted service.

Frequently asked questions

Can we automate if we still use spreadsheets?

Yes, spreadsheets can be part of the workflow. We review how data is maintained, who changes it and which decisions depend on it. With that context, we assess what to keep, connect or organize so the workflow can operate.

Does the entire process need to be automated?

No. We can combine automated actions with human reviews. For example, preparing a proposal and requesting approval before continuing. The design specifies which decisions the system makes and which belong to your team.

What happens if information is missing or a step fails?

We define how to detect and log these situations, who reviews them and how the process resumes. Error handling and alerts are agreed within the scope; not every problem can be resolved automatically.

What if business rules change?

We document rules to make reviews easier. Some adjustments can be handled within contracted support; scope changes or new features require assessment and a proposal before implementation.

What determines implementation cost and time?

The number of steps, systems, decisions and exceptions, plus data quality and available definitions. The proposal specifies deliverables and schedule and identifies third-party tools and costs needed to operate the solution.
